caption:
AI won't fix your lead problem. It will expose it.

Everyone is buying tools right now. Almost nobody is fixing what the tool is pointed at.

Here is what AI genuinely does well in lead generation:

→ It answers in seconds, while you're still on the job
→ It follows up long after a human would have given up
→ It filters out the people who were never going to buy
→ It drafts fast, so you can choose instead of stare

And here is what it cannot do: fix a broken offer.

If the wrong people are saying no to you, automating the conversation only gets you to no faster. The machine amplifies whatever you point it at. Point it at something that works.

Which part is broken in yours? Free 20-minute audit in bio.
